bayts.text: our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And with You make me beloved of the believers and the Muslims, and beloved of the doers of good.
And bless, O All-Knowing, on my behalf, forever, and grant peace upon him who removes toil (Qurʾān 90:4),
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And lead to me the knowledge of the people of righteousness, and write, without removal, my success.
And efface the turning of misfortune toward me, and meet all my adversities together with effacement.
And bless, O Subtle, on my behalf, with peace, him through whom You granted me speech,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And grant me today, without deprivation, forever, what I ask and beyond what I seek.
And bless on my behalf, O You Who make the hard easy, him through whom the journey has reached its end in You,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And bear witness for me today to a gratitude that endures, O Everlasting, Who give wishes and precedence.
And bless, O Guide, without end, on my behalf, and grant peace upon the splendour (of the Prophet),
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And guide all of me on the straight path, and make my little an abundance that does not perish.
And bless, O Loving, on behalf of my person, him whom I have praised at length,
our master Muḥammad, and grant peace; and guide me, love me and teach me.
And bless, O Peace (As-Salām), on my behalf, with peace, him to whom go my prayer of blessing and my peace,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And efface from me all that I have written that was not Your good pleasure: from it I have repented.
And bless, O Subtle, O Forgiving (Al-Ghafūr), him through whom the averse grew gentle,
our master Muḥammad, and grant peace; and through my compositions give the learned their rulings,
his Family and his Companions; and expand my breast through him, O my Sovereign, that it may be expanded (Qurʾān 94:1).
And bless, O Subtle, and grant peace upon my means of approach to You, my ladder,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And grant me today (fulfilled) wishes that last, O You to Whom belong the granting of preference and of precedence.
And efface together, today, the calamities of my exile, and gather for me what I have been pleased with.
And bear witness to my repentance from all my calamities, and from the harm of my turning (elsewhere).
And efface, O All-Aware (Al-Khabīr), all of them that is manifest and all that is hidden, entirely.
And bless, O King, and grant peace upon him who effaced harm as well as pain,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And protect all of me from the harm of subjugation, and from the harm of Satan and of kings,
and from the harm of what You have created or will create, O best of those who protect me and set (me) free.
And bless, O Loving, and grant peace upon the Prophet, the hope of every Muslim,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And fulfil the hope for me forever, and through him accept from me the secret and the open.
And bless, O Most Generous, and grant peace upon the Arab Prophet, the banner,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And grant me exegesis and recitation, and grant me fine elocution (tajwīd) and sweetness.
And through him make my writing honey-sweet, and through him efface my adversities, washed away.
And from the hearts of those who have thought ill of me, drive out, by grace, what I have detested.
And bless, O Accepter of repentance (At-Tawwāb), with the most perfect blessing, and grant peace upon him whose loftiness I make manifest,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
You have widened for me a spaciousness in which others than me holily envy me; You have illumined my abode for me.
And bless, O Peace, with peace, the Prophet possessed of well-known loftiness,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And grant me safety and well-being, and make my life a clear life.
And bless, O Subtle, with peace, the Prophet who removes reproach,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And be subtly kind to me today with what has not been and never will be for any contingent being.
And bless, O You Who make hardships easy, and grant peace upon him who removes disgrace,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And write for me today the glad tidings of the Book, without effacement, ever, nor reproach.
And toward others than me turn the adversities, O Able One Who is never reluctant.
And grant me what You have chosen for me among the sciences, without wandering: truly You are the Enricher (Al-Mughnī), the All-Knowing.
And bless for me all movements and stillnesses, and make them blessings.
And make, by the standing of the Chosen, my habits, out of generosity, like the work of the masters (of the path),
and make, by the right of Your noble Countenance, O Giver of favours and of honour,
these letters equal to all the blessings upon the Prophet, O Answerer of supplications.
Āmīn, O Lord! And make my life great, and in You, through the Chosen, make all of me flourish.
And bless, O King, O Answerer (Al-Mujīb), him by whose standing You answer,
our master Muḥammad, and grant peace, to the Family and the Companions; and teach my heart.
And grant me inspiration and excellence, and make honey-sweet the tongue and the reed-pen.
And make my writing dearer to the Prophet than the writing of others, and (dearer) to You, O Beloved.
And through my speech heal the breasts of the believing people (Qurʾān 9:14), freeing them from reproach.
And through my compositions illumine the hearts of those who seek knowledge in every age.
And bless, O Most Generous, perpetually, him whom You chose and guided, and he rose high,
our master Muḥammad, and grant peace, to the Family and the Companions; and raise my words for me.
And raise my letters with thanks and acceptance, and make Satan and his host despair of me (Qurʾān 7:27).
And bless and grant peace perpetually upon the Prophet and Messenger Aḥmad,
his Family and his Companions; and grant me that to which the noble aspired before me.
